section.text: Share project storage folders with project members

changes.oldText: Project folders can be created only by administrators. Normal users can only access the contents of the project folder created by the administrator. Depending on the system settings, project folders may not be allowed.
changes.newText: A project folder can be created by anyone with permission to create folders in the project, and project members can manage it from the Data page. Depending on the system settings, project folders may not be allowed. Project folder functionality may be restricted based on user permissions.

changes.oldText: Administrators and superadmins can access the Admin Deployments page at /admin/deployments, which provides a cross-project view of every deployment in the cluster. The Project column is available in the deployment list but is hidden by default; you can enable it using the column settings.
changes.oldHtml: Administrators and superadmins can access the Admin Deployments page at /admin/deployments, which provides a cross-project view of every deployment in the cluster. The Project column is available in the deployment list but is hidden by default; you can enable it using the column settings.

changes.oldText: Deployments: Displays the deployment list across all projects and provides the same lifecycle and property filters as the user-facing Deployments page. This cross-project view additionally offers a Project filter property.
changes.newText: Deployments: Displays the deployment list across all projects.
